text: RULES OF SPELLING (1) The most common way to form the plural of a noun is to add an s (Exam- ple: girl, girls; town, towns; hall, halls).
text_raw:
RULES OF SPELLING 
(1) The most common way to form the plural of a noun is to add an s (Exam- 
ple: girl, girls; town, towns; hall, halls).

text: (2) The plural of nouns which end in y following a consonant are formed by dropping the y and adding ies (Example: country, countries; baby, babies; family, families).
(3) The plural of nouns which end in y following a vowel are formed by ad- ding an s (Example: toy, toys; boy, boys; attorney, attorneys).
